findings.claimed: Measured resident weights: 17.89 GiB (19.21 GB) ... versus 21.92 GB for nvidia/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 and 23.42 GB for unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 ... a 2.7 GB smaller resident footprint; table rows 'resident weights | 19.21 GB | 21.92 GB | 23.42 GB' and 'checkpoint size | 28.31 GB | 21.92 GB | 23.42 GB'; 'while holding 4.2 GB less VRAM'
findings.receipt_value: 21.92 GB and 23.42 GB are checkpoint (disk) sizes, not resident weights: docs/01-nvfp4-composition.md L42 and L61 head their sections with them, and docs/07-serving-recommendations.md L509-510 derives them from the 55.56 GB BF16 disk size. Measured resident weight for unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 under identical flags is 21.34 GiB = 22.91 GB (docs/22-results-iteration-2.md L44 and L69), which MODEL_CARD-K5K6.md L88-90 also publishes. Correct resident delta is 22.91 - 19.21 = 3.70 GB, not 2.7 GB and not 4.2 GB
findings.note: the two NVFP4 columns carry the identical value in both the 'resident weights' and 'checkpoint size' rows, which is the tell; the three K5/K6 cards each carry the explicit 'serialized bytes, never VRAM' sentence and are clean

categories_with_no_findings.kv_token_counts: none. 265,122 / 9.28 GiB, 266,612 / 9.31 GiB, 280,017, 272,570, 291,933, 289,577, 9.13 GiB, 37.4 and 33.5 KB/token, 1.01x concurrency - consistent across cards and against receipts/qualification-5090-context.json, receipts/native-mtp-8mp-amendment.json and receipts/context-capacity-5090-budget.json.
categories_with_no_findings.utilisation_value: none. No card prints a stale utilisation for the context edition: every context-edition recipe and every cross-reference reads 0.955 with PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True. The 0.97 mentions are all explicitly the superseded or failed arm; the 0.95 / 0.98 / 0.96 values belong to the online-K6 build's own tester table and the 0.85 to the K4 card's 8,192-token recipe. receipts/qualification-5090-context.json -> qualified_profile.delta_from_published_card still says 'the card prints --gpu-memory-utilization 0.97', which is now historical and no longer true of any card.
categories_with_no_findings.serving_recipes: none. The context card's native recipe, its 196,608 fallback and its inherited-default caveat all match the qualified profile; the hydrated and K5K6 recipes match their own documented profiles.
categories_with_no_findings.task_retention_40_case: none. 35/40 hydrated, 34/40 k5k6, 32/40 context, 33/40 K4, all 40/40 strict passes and zero regressions, matching receipts/task-retention-v2-strict-rescore.json.
categories_with_no_findings.table_column_counts_and_ragged_tables: none. Every table in all four cards has a separator row whose cell count equals its header's, and no row is ragged.
categories_with_no_findings.broken_relative_links_and_anchors: none. Every in-card anchor resolves to a heading in the same card, including #context-capacity, #distribution-tail, #suite-identity, #attention-width-is-a-runtime-knob-and-native-context-needs-the-k4-build, #v5-held-out-suite--10480640-scored-positions and #distribution-fidelity--v5-held-out-suite-10480640-scored-positions.
categories_with_no_findings.assets_present: none. Every asset referenced by a card exists in the repo and in all four published repos, which each carry the identical 16-file assets/ set (context-frontier, context-per-card, fidelity-vs-size, kld-family-comparison, dark and light, svg and png).
categories_with_no_findings.alt_text_present: none missing. Every in all four cards has alt text; accuracy defects are recorded as B4, C6 and C7.
categories_with_no_findings.cross_protocol_ratios: none. No card computes a ratio against turboderp's OpenWebText protocol; the kld-family-comparison alt text states 'the columns are not interchangeable and no ratio between them is meaningful' and 'no y-value because we have never run his protocol', and the GGUF net-of-floor ratios are each bounded in text as estimates rather than identities.
categories_with_no_findings.gguf_rows_marked_as_carrying_the_cross_e: none missing. All four cards carry the 'Every GGUF row above contains that term; no vLLM row - ours or FP8's - does' sentence and the 'KL is not additive, so the net column is an estimate, not an identity' bound.

out_of_scope_observation.card_impact: none - MODEL_CARD-K5K6-context.md L516-518 prints 610.57.04 / CUDA UMD 13.3, which matches the qualification receipt. Reported here only so the receipt owner can fix the verdict receipt.
